$comment: Anti-slop signature corpus. Grows from real audit findings (see docs/plans/2026-07-23-anti-slop-program.md). Each rule: id, severity (P0>P1>P2), kind ('line' = regex per line; 'count-per-file' = >=threshold matching lines in one file), pattern (JS regex source, applied with 'i'? no — case-sensitive), message, setu (rule ref). Suppress on a line with `// slop-allow: <id> <reason>` (line rules) or anywhere in the file (count rules).

rules.message: Side-stripe accent border (>1px left/right). The single most recognizable AI tell. Use a full border, a background tint, a leading marker, or nothing.
Gradient/clipped text. Decorative, never meaningful. Solid colour; emphasis via weight or size.
Four-point sparkle / AI-magic glyph brands the component as generic-AI. Use an icon depicting the real action or the brand mark.
Oversized radius (24px+). Softens the UI into uniform blobs. Use the radius vocabulary: rounded-ds-lg cards, rounded-ds-md controls, pill for tags.
Heavy drop shadow. Devalok forbids card shadows; depth from tonal elevation. Reserve one subtle shadow for true overlays only.
Tracked-uppercase on 3+ roles in one component (caps-on-everything). Caps for at most ONE deliberate role (e.g. data-table column headers); mixed-case for the rest.
